title: Market-Oriented Transformation and Development of Local Government Financing Platforms in China: Exploratory Research Based on Multiple Cases
key_finding: Transformation requires business, management, and financing change; asset integration can be merely formal.
limitations: Small purposive case set; no population-scale fate validation.

title: 硬约束下沉、债务风险演化与基层融资平台退出治理
key_finding: Distinguishes superficial transformation from function peeling, restructuring, and liquidation.
limitations: Prospective governance analysis, not a validated multi-case outcome measure.

title: 融资平台转型、融资成本与地方政府隐性债务结构优化
authors: Li Xiaohong; He Qing; Ai Shuang
population: Chinese city platforms and bond issuers
key_finding: Formal no-government-financing declarations affect pricing while debt need not fall and financing can move to remaining platforms.
limitations: Formal declaration does not establish function removal.

title: 分类监管政策与地方融资平台绩效---来自融资平台退出名单制管理系统的经验证据
key_finding: Monitoring-list exit improves ROA but debt grows and long-term solvency worsens.
limitations: List status is not a function-location measure.

title: Regulating Local Government Financing Vehicles and Public-Private Partnerships in China
key_finding: Regulation should follow fiscal function regardless of label and guard against relabeling.
limitations: National diagnosis, not an exit sample.

title: China's Local Government Debt: The Grand Bargain
key_finding: Central-local arrangements enabled backdoor finance and limited front-door reform.
limitations: Does not classify exit fates or test local historical capacity.

title: Press conference on increasing the local-government debt-limit replacement policy
authors: Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China
key_finding: Specifies project identification, multi-level review, statutory-debt conversion, monitoring, and data sharing.
limitations: Describes intended policy, not achieved implementation.

title: Intergovernmental Fiscal Reform in China
key_finding: Formal fiscal reforms can coexist with new off-budget channels.
limitations: National diagnosis rather than city-level exit study.

title: The Financing of Local Government in China: Stimulus Loan Wanes and Shadow Banking Waxes
key_finding: Maturing bank loans were followed by bonds and shadow-banking instruments.
limitations: Not an exit study; limited real-effect evidence.

title: The Institutional Logic of Collusion among Local Governments in China
key_finding: Uniform mandates can produce coordinated evasion and temporary compliance.
limitations: Policy areas other than local debt.

title: The Development of Local Government Financial Vehicles in China: A Case Study of Jiaxing Chengtou
key_finding: Monitoring-list exit coexisted with continuing public ownership, functions, and later regrouping.
limitations: One disclosure-rich case.

title: The Financial Value of the Within-Government Political Network: Evidence from Chinese Municipal Corporate Bonds
key_finding: Government ties predict lower issuance spreads and can sustain implicit-guarantee perceptions.
limitations: Residual endogeneity; prices are not administrative implementation.

title: Long Live Keju! The Persistent Effects of China's Civil Examination System
key_finding: Jinshi density predicts schooling through education, culture, and social capital; Communist-era political-elite continuity is absent.
limitations: Outcome is human capital, not LGFV reform.

title: From Smoke and Mirrors to Walking the Talk: Decoupling in the Contemporary World
key_finding: Separates policy-practice from means-ends decoupling.
limitations: Propositions are not all tested findings.

title: De- and Recoupling and Public Regulation
key_finding: Decomposes goal, management system, practice, and outcome links.
limitations: Small voluntary sample with unresolved durability.

title: Making Self-Regulation More Than Merely Symbolic: The Critical Role of the Legal Environment
key_finding: Commitments were followed by stronger inspection outcomes under sustained surveillance.
limitations: Setting-specific and no clean practice/outcome separation.

title: Decoupling Practical and Legal Compliance: Analysis of Member States' Implementation of EU Policy
key_finding: Legal and practical compliance differ; administrative capacity and social support predict less decoupling.
limitations: Small directive set and mixed practical indicators.

title: Is Decoupling Becoming Decoupled from Institutional Theory? A Commentary on Wijen
key_finding: Warns against merging policy-practice and means-ends decoupling and emphasizes temporal dynamics.
limitations: Short commentary, not an empirical test.

title: Text as Data: The Promise and Pitfalls of Automatic Content Analysis Methods for Political Texts
key_finding: Validation is application-specific and requires held-out class-specific assessment.
limitations: Pre-LLM and no universal downstream correction.

title: Using Imperfect Surrogates for Downstream Inference: Design-Based Supervised Learning for Social Science Applications of Large Language Models
key_finding: High accuracy need not yield valid regression; correction requires known positive label-sampling probabilities.
limitations: Predicted outcomes only and assumes credible gold labels.

title: Codebook LLMs: Evaluating LLMs as Measurement Tools for Political Science Concepts
key_finding: Full-codebook and class-level behavioral tests expose shortcuts hidden by aggregate scores.
limitations: Three datasets and time-sensitive models; no downstream correction.

title: Testing Causal Theories with Learned Proxies
key_finding: Human labels and models can be contaminated; uncertainty and held-out confusion data matter.
limitations: Identification rests on explicit assumptions.

title: Misclassification in Automated Content Analysis Causes Bias in Regression. Can We Fix It? Yes We Can!
key_finding: Misclassification can attenuate, exaggerate, or reverse coefficients despite strong predictive metrics.
limitations: Correction needs a correctly specified error model and adequate validation data.

title: ChatGPT Outperforms Crowd Workers for Text-Annotation Tasks
key_finding: GPT-3.5 outperformed crowd workers on several common tasks.
limitations: Single vintage, agreement-conditioned gold labels, and no downstream inference.
